scope: Fixed reference arm. The image, SDK, patches, serving entry and per-variant argv are pinned; this profile exposes no tunable parameter and has no r4/r5/r6/r7/r8 style revisions. Run-to-run variation comes only from the paired controller, which appends its shared pre-measurement warmup extension and selects the warmup protocol. Historical results keep their own dated identities.

serving.launcher_behavior: Record actual torch/torch_npu/vllm/vllm_ascend import paths and hashes, verify the frozen entry sha256, then run the entry in-process.

originals.hash_semantics: asset_sha256 is the downloaded release asset and is checked against the GitHub asset digest; manifest_sha256 is the pinned manifest member inside the archive and is what the deployment records as original_manifest_sha256. They are different values and must not be swapped.

runtime/entrypoints/prepare_retrieval_b0.role: text variant argv source: the single `serve_args` literal, read by AST in scripts/baseline_entry.py

runtime/entrypoints/serve_b0_r2.py.role: frozen serving entry; its sha256 is re-verified before execution and recorded in the service plan

originals.verification: scripts/restore_b1_r4.py re-derives every deployed file from the two SHA256-pinned manifests and re-checks all of them before NPU initialisation, so the restored hashes above are startup-verified rather than copied from a single receipt. The archive member paths inside the tarballs are not restated here; the deployment-relative paths are the stable identities.

variant_selection.rule: HLE solver stage uses `multimodal`; every other kind (continuous, joint MMLU quality, frontier, SWE, terminal) uses `text`.
variant_selection.code: scripts/baseline_entry.py determines the variant from the dataset spec and passes it to scripts/baseline_admission.py.
variant_selection.text_non_continuous: For kind != continuous the text argv drops `--reasoning-parser qwen3`; the multimodal argv always keeps its original parser.
variant_selection.eager_refused: Any restored argv containing --enforce-eager is rejected before model start.

text.argv_digest_rule: sha256 over json.dumps(argv, separators=(",", ":")) of the list before the controller appends anything.

resources.note: 20 GiB is set explicitly for the text variant only; no gpu-memory-utilization flag is used.

multimodal.argv_digest_rule: sha256 over json.dumps(argv, separators=(",", ":")) of the `argv` array in the profile file.

resources.note: No 20 GiB reservation for this variant; the original utilization fraction decides the KV budget.

multimodal.differences_are_original: Both variants are archived original recipes; they are not interchangeable and are selected per dataset.

controller_appended.condition: Only when the paired B1 deployment enables the shared pre-measurement warmup; also adds the restored scripts directory to PYTHONPATH.
controller_appended.not_b0_optimization: This is shared measurement plumbing applied to both arms, not a B0 configuration or an improvement claim.

changes: remove text_config.rope_parameters.mrope_section and mrope_interleaved so target and independently loaded MTP draft use 1-D positions
model_view.applies_to: text variant only; multimodal uses the model directory as-is

per_run_paths.ASCEND_RT_VISIBLE_DEVICES: logical devices passed by --devices; physical cards verified by npu-smi

resources_shared.memory_preflight: 32 MiB pinned allocation and round trip on each card before weight load; checkpoint-only POSIX_FADV_DONTNEED hints and raw cgroup reserve checks are shared with B1
resources_shared.reuse_policy: B0 is never merged with B1 state; each arm runs on a fresh output directory and fresh compiler cache

warmup.selection: scripts/serving_warmup.py for continuous C8 and dataset kinds; scripts/completion_warmup.py for acceptance and context/tenant supplements. Cohorts, extra cohorts and policy names depend on the run kind and the paired B1 release, not on B0.
warmup.recorded_per_run: The effective protocol and its observation counts are written into each run's plan and receipt.
warmup.controller_appended: See serving.controller_appended; the same extension is appended to both arms.

qualification.text_arm: Completed on 2026-11-15 (context/tenant supplement A01, physical cards 1 and 6, logical 0 and 1); receipt status completed, quiescent, service and client started.
qualification.five_datasets: Unchanged by this profile; B0 quality, performance and cost claims keep the evidence of their own dated runs.
not_claimed: No B0 tuning or candidate promotion is implied by this file.
The controller-appended compile-boundary extension is shared measurement plumbing, not a B0 improvement.
Historical SDK byte equivalence is limited to the pinned image plus the original backports; host OS, driver and compiler are observed separately.

observed_serving.plan_serve_args: 41 base arguments plus the 2 controller-appended arguments

observed_warmup.source: scripts/completion_warmup.py, selected because this run carried an acceptance contract

open_items: This profile is loaded and cross-checked by scripts/baseline_profile.py before model start; the run records its sha256, the selected variant and the final argv.

The text argv is a fixed copy of the restored original. If a future release restores a different original, the restored file and this profile must be reconciled explicitly rather than silently drifting.
